points.description: First advantage: multiples valuation is quick / convenient / easy and simple to use (synonyms such as fast, simple, easy to apply accepted).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated (e.g. 'useful' or 'easy' with no link to speed or convenience).

points.description: Second advantage: it uses market-based data that reflects the market's growth and risk expectations (market sentiment/pricing of comparable firms).
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'market-based' or 'uses comparables' is stated without reference to reflecting growth/risk expectations.

rubric.notes: Award full marks when both advantages are given, in either order and in any wording with clear synonyms: quick/convenient/simple, and market-based data reflecting growth and risk expectations. Give part marks for a vague or half-stated version of an advantage, such as 'market-based' without growth/risk. Give no marks for unrelated or wrong advantages, such as accuracy or being based on detailed cash flow forecasts. Each blank is marked separately.
